links.outcome: Fact-checking module accuracy against EHR ground-truth propositions
links.effect: Precision 0.8904, recall 0.8234, F1-score 0.8556 on 3786 propositions extracted from 104 summaries.
links.quote: The fact-checking module achieves a precision of 0.8904, a recall of 0.8234, and an F1-score of 0.8556.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning a domain-specific summarization LLM with LoRA on MIMIC-III to reduce hallucination
Granular numerical and logical fact-checking of LLM summaries against EHR using discrete logic, independent of the LLM

screen.reason: Evaluates an automated post-generation fact-checking module designed to detect hallucinations and validate LLM outputs against EHR data.

primary.practice: automated fact-checking module / output validation against EHR
